ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.metaDescription: Who's behind JessyIsCrafting, and why craftsmanship, little details and work made with care matter so much.
ourStory.heading: The person behind JessyIsCrafting
paragraphs: I'm Jessy, the person behind JessyIsCrafting. It all started as a way to unwind from everyday life and, little by little, became my favorite way of making beautiful things with my hands.

To me, craftsmanship means time: time to choose good materials, to take care of every stroke, and to repeat a detail as many times as it takes to get it right. Nothing leaves here unless I'm happy with the result.

Every piece is designed, painted and prepared by hand in Spain, with materials I try to choose with care and purpose. The small details — a well-used wood grain, a color gradient, a careful finish — are, to me, what turns an object into a keepsake.
ourStory.quote: What I make, I make with care.

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.metaDescription: Video games, Kingdom Come: Deliverance, reading and writing: the stories that inspire every piece of JessyIsCrafting.
inspiration.intro: Everything I make draws from what I love: video games, reading, and well-told stories.
inspiration.kcdText1: If there's one video game that shaped this project, it's Kingdom Come: Deliverance. I fell in love with its medieval Bohemia from the very first moment: the forests, the light, the clothing, every small object with its own story.
inspiration.kcdText2: Its soundtrack keeps me company while I work, almost as much as my brushes do. And that aesthetic — earth, wood, iron, natural fabrics — is what truly inspires the colors and textures of JessyIsCrafting.
inspiration.readingText: Outside the workshop you'll almost always find me with a book, or writing one. I've spent time writing fanfiction set in the world of Kingdom Come: Deliverance, purely out of love for its characters and its world.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.metaDescription: Shipping, preparation times, returns and customization: everything you need to know before ordering from JessyIsCrafting.
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about shipping, timelines, returns and customization. If you have another question, feel free to write to me.

items.question: Which countries do you ship to?
items.answer: I regularly ship across the whole European Union and to the United Kingdom. If you're elsewhere, write to me before ordering so we can look into options together.

items.question: How long does it take to prepare my order?
items.answer: Every piece is handmade, so timelines vary depending on the product and whether it's customized. As a rough guide, between 3 and 10 business days before shipping; around dates like Christmas, this can take longer.

items.question: Can I return a product?
items.answer: For non-customized products, I accept returns within 14 days of receipt, as long as they're in their original condition. Customized or made-to-order pieces can't be returned, except in case of a manufacturing fault.

items.question: Can I order a customized piece?
items.answer: Yes. Many products support customization of color, size or details. Mention it in your order or write to me beforehand to confirm options and timing.

items.question: I live outside the EU or UK, can I still order?
items.answer: Write to me before placing your order and let me know your location; I'll look at each case depending on the product and shipping costs.

items.question: How can I pay?
items.answer: I'll confirm the available payment method with you when we finalize your order by message or email, depending on the product and shipping method.
